title: SharpAPI sportsbook odds
description: Pulls current sportsbook odds from SharpAPI into a dataset, one row per price. Bring your own SharpAPI key; a free key covers DraftKings and FanDuel.

apiKey.title: SharpAPI key
apiKey.description: Your own SharpAPI key. The free SharpAPI plan covers DraftKings and FanDuel. The key is stored as a secret input and is never written to the log or the dataset.

sportsbook.title: Sportsbooks
sportsbook.description: Which sportsbooks to pull. Each one is requested on its own, so a sportsbook your plan does not include is skipped with a note that names the plan it needs, and the rest still run.

league.title: League
league.description: League to filter on, for example nfl, nba, mlb or nhl. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every league.

marketType.title: Market
marketType.description: Moneyline is the full game winner line, including three way lines that have a draw. Spread also covers run lines, puck lines, handicaps and period spreads. Total covers every total, including period and team totals. Leave empty for every market.

liveOnly.title: Live games only
liveOnly.description: Only return prices for games in progress. When off, both upcoming and live games are returned.

maxItems.title: Maximum prices
maxItems.description: Stop after saving this many rows in total. Sportsbooks are fetched in the order listed, so with no league or market filter the first one can fill the whole limit. Add a league or market, or raise the limit, to see every sportsbook.
